ppe_detector.name: ppe_detector

previous_version.reason_superseded: Validation-split threshold sweep (models/evaluation/ppe_threshold_sweep.json) showed no_helmet recall plateaued at 0.237 across every tested confidence threshold (0.05-0.40), a model-capacity ceiling rather than a threshold-tuning problem. This justified resuming the ORIGINAL interrupted 60-epoch training run (scripts/resume_vision_training.py, resume=True from the same optimizer/scheduler state, train/val split only, seed unchanged) rather than starting a new experiment. Retained here, never deleted -- see docs/README.md for the full before/after comparison.

ppe_detector.dataset_license: AGPL-3.0 (Ultralytics YOLO11 code/weights and Construction-PPE dataset)
ppe_detector.runtime_confidence_thresholds_source: backend/app/inference/ppe_thresholds.json (validation-split PR sweep, scripts/tune_ppe_thresholds.py, re-run against the v1.1 checkpoint)

training_config.resumed_from: v1.0 checkpoint (epoch 36/60 interrupted state), scripts/resume_vision_training.py, resume=True, same optimizer/scheduler/seed

ppe_detector.note: v1.0 training was externally interrupted at epoch 36/60. A validation-split threshold sweep on v1.0 (models/evaluation/ppe_threshold_sweep_v1.0.json) showed no_helmet recall plateaued at 0.237 across every tested confidence threshold, indicating a model-capacity limit rather than a threshold problem -- this was the validation evidence used to justify a targeted continuation-training experiment rather than a from-scratch retrain. v1.1 resumed the SAME interrupted run to its original 60-epoch target from the saved optimizer/scheduler state (train/val split only, same seed=42, no test-split access during training or tuning). Every held-out test-set metric improved or held steady (see test_set_comparison_v1.0_to_v1.1 above); person precision moved by -0.009, within run-to-run noise. Promoted to default per the task's promotion criteria. Trained on the full 11-class published label set unmodified; the runtime adapter filters to person/helmet/vest/no_helmet only. v1.0 artifact, metrics, and thresholds are preserved (see previous_version above), never deleted.

forecast_gru.name: forecast_gru
forecast_gru.note: Predicts the residual against a cutoff-anchored physics forecast (combined = physics + residual), never an unconstrained absolute concentration.
